# Atlassian Provider

Use the Atlassian provider to manage Atlassian Cloud resources.

Authentication can be supplied through the provider block or the
`ATLASSIAN_SITE_URL`, `ATLASSIAN_EMAIL`, and `ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN` environment
variables.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Atlassian API token. May also be set with ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN.
- `email` (String) Email address used for Atlassian API authentication. May also be set with ATLASSIAN_EMAIL.
- `site_url` (String) Atlassian Cloud site URL. May also be set with ATLASSIAN_SITE_URL.
